::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
ASML's first standalone India presence — a legal entity plus a customer-support office in GIFT City, Gujarat, hiring 20-30 engineering graduates initially. Distinct from (and a step beyond) its lithography-supply MoU with Tata's Dholera fab, which remains tracked as a milestone on Tata's own facility page. Growth here is explicitly tied to Dholera's success, so treat this as an early, small-scale support footprint rather than a major manufacturing investment.
:::

## What does this facility supply?

Customer support and service operations for ASML's lithography systems supplied to Indian fabs, primarily Tata's Dholera fab.

## Project Timeline

- **01 Sep 2026** — ASML establishes an Indian legal entity and begins India operations
- **19 Sep 2026** — ASML confirms plans for a customer support office in GIFT City, Gujarat, hiring 20-30 engineering graduates initially
